description: Issue #177 (a): the acceptance criteria cite the verify runner the way a criterion normally does — `bash .claude/skills/cmate-verify/scripts/verify-run.sh --cwd .` as the command that must return RESULT passed, and `.commandmate/verify.yaml` as the gate that must go green. Neither is a deliverable; both are the harness that JUDGES this issue. Before #177 both landed in suspected_files, i.e. in the worker's scope.allow, so the worker could pass the gate by rewriting the judge — and the only thing preventing it was the author remembering not to write the path. They are now denied by default and reported in reference_files ("read, not in scope.allow"), which keeps the runner readable to the worker without making it writable. Nothing else moves: web/src/lib/filter.ts and its derived test companions stay in scope, and the run stays a clean success — a deny that fires on the NORMAL way to write an acceptance criterion must not cost a warning.
